outcome: Cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate pattern
cohort: 818 intrapartum singleton pregnancies with gestational age > 34 weeks, in the latent phase and with intact membranes
finding: Indeterminate patterns of cardiotocography can predict adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, particularly due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate patterns, was significantly more frequent in indeterminate admission test results compared to normal ones.
